title: Kinnow reference scope
summary: This first whole-crop page demonstrates the complete reference structure. Plant protection is reviewed more deeply than cultivation sections, which will expand as source-backed records are added.

title: Climate guidance pending
summary: Add location-specific temperature, frost, heat, and rainfall guidance from an authoritative Kinnow source before treating this section as operational advice.

title: Drainage affects protection decisions
summary: Inspect basin drainage and the trunk base when decline or collar symptoms appear. This is a protection-context reminder, not a complete site-selection prescription.

title: Variety comparison pending
summary: Variety, rootstock, maturity, yield, and disease-susceptibility claims will be added only with cultivar-specific source evidence.

title: Planting guidance pending
summary: Planting material, spacing, pit preparation, and orchard density require source-backed records with geography and production-system scope.

title: Pruning guidance pending
summary: Future records will distinguish structural pruning from sanitation and will include timing, tool hygiene, and disease-risk boundaries.

title: Test before correcting leaf yellowing
summary: Leaf colour alone does not confirm a nutrient deficiency. Future nutrient guidance will require soil or leaf-test context and look-alike checks.

title: Irrigation schedule pending
summary: Water stress and waterlogging can change crop risk and treatment eligibility. Add a locally scoped irrigation schedule before using this section for application timing.

title: Weed plan pending
summary: Identify the weed and its location before selecting a management method. No herbicide instruction is published in this reference yet.

title: Harvest guidance pending
summary: Harvest indicators and timing need Kinnow-specific source records. Until then, check the pre-harvest interval on any exact product label before harvest.

title: Post-harvest guidance pending
summary: Post-harvest handling guidance will be added from product- and market-specific sources rather than copied from general citrus pages.
